items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022! ### This year's UK National Championship ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2023
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2023! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering as there is lots of information which will be new to you, even if you are an experienced competitor. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#32058-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2023, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2023 t-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your t-shirt size.** **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only; the fee must be paid at the competition. We accept cash or card payments. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by *9th October 2023*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. There are no qualifications in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, or Skewb, so **newcomers will be able to compete in these events only**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2023). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2023. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0pMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bcff7b5bdf0f0846e919c48b2fc43d8a54c9d36f/UKC%202023%20LOGO%20-%20RGB%20(FOR%20SCREENS)%20-%20(TRANSPARENT)%20-%20(WITH%20SPONSORSHIP).png)

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2024
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2024! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#41928-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2024, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2024 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Guests:** A fee of £5 for a guest wristband will be due for all spectators and competitors' guests. They will be available on the door, payable via cash or card. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** Please note that the guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only. **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by October 22nd you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1: 6 UK competitors; 3x3: 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2024. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbng5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--153ecb54fb75b7956c0701cb174dca72201b0444/image.png)

items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025! ### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) ![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png) #### New Competitors: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. #### Free T-Shirt: By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes). #### Qualifications: **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. #### Spectators and Guests: Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book. #### Prizes: As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete. #### Podium Positions: If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round. #### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025: The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship. #### Invitation Letters: Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition). #### Media Enquiries: Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2025, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2025 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 10th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 6 UK competitors will be [guaranteed to progress](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#9p2b) into the finals for all events, in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3, the top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at the Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcxNjY5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a8ab6aa393063e4885b78fe22730fbdb06d76ab9/Kewbz%20UKC26%20LOGO.jpg) ## Welcome to the Kewbz UK Championship 2026! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending the Kewbz UK Championship 2026, you'll receive a Kewbz UK Championship 2026 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** This competition is open to first-time competitors, who will only be able to compete in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and 3x3 One-Handed. If you would like to attempt to qualify for other events, you must do so another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 16th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **there are no qualifications for 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, or 3x3 One-Handed.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals for all events. In 3x3, any non-UK competitors faster than the 8th UK competitor will compete together, before UK competitors face off in seeded pairs. In other events, all 16 finalists will compete together, with the [top 8 UK competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b) being joined by the 8 remaining best competitors from any region. **Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind:** These events will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for these events, you must compete at the [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2026) or the [Kewbz UK Blindfolded Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKBLDChampionship2026). The podium winners of these competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2026. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.
